tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Things to do on one day near one US town (trivia, live music, karaoke, comedy, games, markets, talks and more), each checked against the page it came from. Give the town the person asked about ("Denver, CO", "Tampa, FL" or "Sacramento, CA") or a 5-digit ZIP, a date, and optionally a kind of event. W

tools.name: report_listing_problem
tools.description: Use when the person says a Suumer listing is wrong (the time changed, it was cancelled or moved, the place is wrong, it is not open to the public) and wants Suumer told, or agrees when you offer. Sends one report to Suumer's review queue holding only the listing and which part is wrong, picked from

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: report_listing_problem · Public sink: report_listing_problem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: report_listing_problem · Public sink: report_listing_problem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_events" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
